purpose: Machine-readable plumbing design/checking rules derived from code structure and publicly accessible code information.

rules.condition: Sanitary drainage pipe sizing is not justified by the applicable drainage sizing method/table.
rules.action: Require fixture-unit/load based sizing and code table verification.
rules.source_note: Chapter 7 governs sanitary drainage design, installation and sizing.

rules.condition: A drainage system is arranged so that sewage can backflow into fixtures or occupied areas.
rules.action: Check elevation, backwater protection and drainage layout.
rules.source_note: Derived engineering check; exact exceptions require code review.
